qualification_notes.content:
# Fresh packed strong-focus candidate

`focus-fresh-maintained.patch` is the frozen isolated proposal. Product path is `projects/ngx-material-legacy/styles/core/focus-indicators/_focus-indicators.scss` (412 bytes, SHA-256 e2ad7e073a9dd1954dc85a5816cc5f9c05644b9d441abc1359847b31b30f7f73). It retains the two original owned historical mixin includes first, then uses the peer's public `mat.strong-focus-indicators` with the original historical black/display defaults merged before consumer config. No private peer symbol, direct private CSS variable, selector modification, consumer CSS change or current m2-* call is introduced. Peer public mixin's additional current chip overflow-visible behavior is intentional subject to review; it visibly unclamps a tested long label from 134px to 695px, matching an independently compiled/consumed public peer strong-focus control.

Fresh tarball SHA-256 de6ffdb22268d884037f4661bf8972dc04531cbf0a5eb97f008728e57c54a840, built from dirty isolated b4f worktree with pinned Node 24.21.0/npm 11.19.0. Its 512 extracted members were individually rehashed; compared with b4f baseline tarball 770750703325dce13278c234eccbfaea0710fcf9c1a4ff98977ff122213e4139, exactly one member differs, the product Sass file above. It is an experimental pack, not a sealed release receipt. The maintained tests `tests/strong_focus_companion_probe.mjs` and `tests/test_strong_focus_companion.py` compile seven configs, assert caller map unchanged, compare historical declarations first and the public current peer output thereafter, and pass on source and the fresh extracted package. The same check fails on the baseline as a negative control. No golden changed.

Pinned Chromium 149 normal and forced-colors each: 29/29 observational checks on both baseline and fresh pack. In normal colors baseline peer MatSortHeader has both 3px focus ring and 1px underline; fresh candidate has ring only for public FocusMonitor keyboard/program origins, default/custom config. Independent peer strong-focus control behaves the same as fresh candidate for actual modern long ChipOption focused ring geometry and visible overflow under default, owned historical M2 Sass context, and peer M3; this does not claim modern M2 token consumption. Actual legacy option snapshots match exactly for default/custom, null, false, CSS var, repeated, theme-before/after, display null/none and both media modes; actual legacy chip focus and selected mixed-theme snapshots match. The compiled baseline CSS is an unchanged ordered subsequence of candidate CSS in the bounded fixture. A public peer `display:none` config emits fallback suppression even while hiding the ring; with `display:false` both legacy and independent peer omit the display declaration, so it inherits rather than necessarily hiding the ring, while peer/fresh still emit fallback suppression. This reflects current companion behavior, not a claim that every such consumer intentionally wants hidden focus.

FocusMonitor.focusVia simulates keyboard/program origins; no trusted Tab input. Forced-colors is Chromium emulation, not all OS/browsers. No full Sass/golden gate, all-family suite, dark theme, security or publication review was run. Earlier unconditional public-color prepend failed inherited null-color parity and is rejected. Prior 42d/ce13 artifacts are historical only. No canonical/source-tree/Cyph changes. A read-only Cyph scan found no `strong-focus-indicators` usage and found its MatLegacyChipsModule import and several legacy mat-chip-list templates; absence of a literal Sass mixin does not prove absence of indirect CSS configurations. Raw logs, scripts, compiled outputs, artifact hashes and limitations are in fresh-qualification-manifest.json.

The final test files carry the repository MIT Google and 2026 Ryan Lester notices. This Sass probe is an integration invariant: it compares the byte-unchanged owned helper's generated declarations with the full public peer mixin output and their order. It is not an independently sourced historical golden for the helper's internals. Final test files were rerun after the notice-only changes; packed product bytes and the fresh browser results were unchanged.

limits: Keyboard/program origins supplied through public FocusMonitor; trusted Tab interaction not claimed.
Forced colors emulated with Chromium --force-high-contrast, not a complete OS/browser matrix.
The modern-chip historical M2 Sass context is not proof of current-peer M2 color-token consumption.
Fresh candidate is an isolated pack. Final committed artifact, full651/31 Sass checks, complete browser/floor and G11 qualification remain required.
